result.title: Differentiable Virtual-Slot Partitioning for Adaptive Tokenization in Vision Transformers
result.summary: Adaptive tokenization aims to reduce the compute spent on uninformative image regions while preserving accuracy. Existing work relies on (i) fixed or frozen scoring rules, which cannot be trained toward the task loss, or (ii) discrete masks trained with straight-through estimators, which yield noisy gradients, while fully differentiable alternatives instead leave the pre-trained regular grid. We revisit adaptive tokenization from a regular-grid perspective and ask: can a two-scale quadtree be learned end-to-end without deleting a single token during training? We show that one coarse token and its four fine children can be made the two endpoints of a single continuous interpolation. We introduce Differentiable Virtual-Slot Partitioning (\dvsp{}), which keeps four \emph{virtual slots} per $2{\times}2$ region and blends their token features and attention mass with a single weight $α$, exactly reproducing the discrete grid at $α\in \{0,1\}$. On COCO detection with EVA-02-B, \dvsp{} retains $97.9\%$ of dense Box AP while removing $64.2\%$ of visual tokens, giving a $1.61\times$ end-to-end speedup, and it outperforms entropy-based APT, DART, and uniform lower-resolution dense adaptation at matched budgets; these gains depend on the conserved attention mass, whose removal costs $1.59$ Box AP. On a frozen Segmenter it also improves Cityscapes mIoU, and on frozen DeiT backbones it exceeds entropy selection at identical per-image token counts.

AI.brief_summary: 提出可微虚拟槽划分 DVSP：在 2×2 区域内保留四个虚拟槽，用单一权重 α 连续插值粗 token 与细 token 的特征和注意力质量，使离散网格成为 α∈{0,1} 的端点，从而端到端学习视觉 token 的自适应取舍。
AI.relevance_reason: 其可微软 token 选择与注意力质量守恒，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 token 预算的端到端监督提供线索，但该文面向训练期效率而非多模态推理状态，需核查是否适用于推理流程。
